standards.text: The learners demonstrate an understanding of fundamental concepts and principles of syntax and elements in Hyper Text Mark-Up Language (HTML) and the properties and values used in Cascading Style Sheet (CSS) in developing and designing a website.
The learners create a web portfolio using Hyper Text Mark-Up Language (HTML).
The learners demonstrate an understanding of fundamental principles, syntax, and the properties and values of Cascading Style Sheet (CSS) rule in designing and developing interactive webpages.
The learners create a web portfolio applying Cascading Style Sheet (CSS) rules.
Demonstrate an understanding of the principles of web responsive development by using JavaScript functions and C# programming language.
The learners create a web application project using JavaScript and C# programming language.

Demonstrate an understanding of the principles of responsive web development by exploring features of ASP.NET Model View Controller architecture and back-end database, conversion of web to mobile application, and computation of service costing.

The learners create a web application following the procedures of managing the list of tasks of Creating, Reading, Updating, and Deleting (CRUD) operations with a database backend, conversion of web to mobile application, and computation of service costing.
